Description: The Application Context of Audio Scene Management (CAE-ASM) for the JSON Interface (MMC-JSI): what, beyond the schema of the User Command, describes the application. It is data of the Access of the implementation 1MMC-JSI-V2.5-I02 (Setting ApplicationContext), beside the schema of the User Command (Settings CommandSchema and ResponseSchema, one schema for both: the request is UserCommandRQ, the response UserCommandRS).
Application: The application edits an audio scene: sounds (objects) placed around a listener, the user. A command moves, turns, adds, removes or plays objects, sets their loudness, moves the listener, or undoes an earlier command.
Conventions:
Positions are in metres: x right of the user, y ahead, z up; the user is at (0, 0, 0) facing +y. An orientation is (alpha, beta, gamma) in degrees and only gamma is used: 0 faces away from the user, 180 faces the user, 90 faces the user's left, 270 the user's right.
The field by the verb:
- MovedObjects (the NEW position and orientation of an object): move, shift, push, bring, put, place, raise, lift, lower, drop, turn, rotate, nearer, closer, farther, forward, back.
- ChangedObjects (a Level in LUFS, negative: "minus 20" is -20): louder, quieter, softer, the level of an object. LUFS alone is for the whole scene.
- AddedObjects: add, bring in. RemovedObjects: remove, take out. DeliveredObject: play, let me hear (the scene has a name too). UserPoV: the listener (me, I, let me listen). RevokedUserCommandID: undo, go back (a command sent before, the last unless another is said).
A change by d from the current position (see the state of the application) changes ONE coordinate: right x+d; left x-d; forward, ahead y+d; back, behind y-d; up, raise, lift z+d; down, lower, drop z-d; closer, nearer: the distance from (0, 0, 0) gets d smaller (an object ahead y-d, behind y+d); farther: d larger (ahead y+d, behind y-d). "To x, y, z" is as said. A turn keeps the position; "by n degrees" adds n to gamma.
Another word may stand for an object (fiddle: violin; singer, vocals: voice; keyboard: piano). Stop, save, open and close are not commands: answer a Problem.

Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.MovedObjects: Moves, places or turns objects: the new position and orientation. Also bringing closer or farther, raising, lowering, pushing, shifting.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.MovedObjects.Objects.NewSp: [x, y, z] in metres: x right (+) or left (-), y forward (+) or back (-), z up (+) or down (-); closer to the user is y smaller.
[alpha, beta, gamma] in degrees; only gamma turns the object.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.ChangedObjects: Sets the loudness of one object, in LUFS: only for louder, quieter, softer, level. Never for raise, lower, up, down, closer, nearer, farther: those move the object (MovedObjects).
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.ChangedObjects.Objects.Lev: The loudness of the object, in LUFS (negative).
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.LUFS: The loudness of the whole scene, in LUFS (negative).
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.AddedObjects: Adds stored sounds to the scene, at a position.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.AddedObjects.Objects.Spati: [x, y, z] in metres where the sound is put.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.DeliveredObject: Plays an object, or the whole scene (its name).
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.UserPoV: Moves the listener (the user), not an object: where the user listens from.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.UserPoV.CartPosition: [x, y, z] in metres of the listener.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.UserPoV.Orientation: [alpha, beta, gamma] in degrees of the listener.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.RevokedUserCommandID: Undoes an earlier command: its identifier.

Reminder: MovedObjects for move, raise, lower, closer, nearer, farther, forward, back and turn (a position is never a loudness); ChangedObjects only for louder, quieter or LUFS; change one coordinate by the amount; use only the names above.

Hints.Text: to the right is x bigger.
to the left is x smaller.
closer: the distance from (0, 0, 0) gets smaller (an object with y > 0: y smaller; with y < 0: y bigger).
farther: the distance from (0, 0, 0) gets bigger (an object with y > 0: y bigger; with y < 0: y smaller, more negative).
a turn changes gamma only; the position stays as it is.

Refusals.Problem: To load a sound, press the Load a sound button, and tell me what to call it.
That is not something I can do with the audio scene.
